description: NXP FRDM-IMX91S Linux image target flashed from a Linux host with NXP UUU and verified over the board's USB-C debug UART.

backendNotes.target: The selected UUU command flashes the full Product Linux image. Set workspace.target.serial to the first CH343 USB-UART device when serialVerify is enabled.
backendNotes.download: Put SW1 into Serial Downloader mode and connect the board USB OTG/download port. The USB-C debug UART is a separate console connection.
